name: two-player
description: Reach the two-player P1->P2 handoff so the 2P save/restore routines run, and pixel-validate them against MAME.
_grounding: Two credits (coin@400 + coin@440; a 2-player start deducts two BCD credits) then 2 Players Start@520; poke 0xA800=0xF0@660 forces P1's death (the destroyed code the collision sweeps write; precondition ship alive 0xA800==0xFF, true from f632). Game-set handoff at f974: ACTIVE_PLAYER 0xAD32 0->1. Exercises startTwoPlayerGame(0x189e), handPlayOverToOtherPlayer(0x1226), loadActivePlayerContextAndPostRoundHud(0x4c75, copies P2's save block). Deterministic (forced death, era stays 0 -> no entropy). See scratchpad/twoplayer-recipe.md.
